description.value: Super Great Pizza is a small, no-frills pizza-by-the-slice shop located directly across from Joyce-Collingwood SkyTrain Station in East Vancouver, making it an exceptionally easy pit stop for cyclists on or near the Central Valley Greenway. The shop is known for generous cheese and toppings across a rotating variety of slices, with indoor seating available though limited. Takeout is the dominant mode here, well-suited to a quick refuel on the go.
